paragraphs.text: Marvel Super Heroes Jumpstart is a supplemental Magic booster set with mostly reprints and some new cards. It was released on June 6, 2026, concurrently with the Marvel Super Heroes main set.

Marvel Super Heroes is part of the Jumpstart series . The Jumpstart format allows players to skip the deckbuilding portion of constructed and other limited formats by using unique 20-card half deck boosters. To play a game of Jumpstart , players open two of the half-deck packs and shuffle them together to form a ready-to-play deck. The set is designed for two-player gameplay, but players can also play multiplayer with it. Like previous iterations of Jumpstart products, the Marvel Super Heroes Jumpstart has 51 unique booster themes spanning the Marvel roster. Unlike those previous iterations, Marvel Jumpstart does not have pack variations. Each pack will always contain the same set of cards.

The set features feature 172 new cards and 61 reprints (including 12 cards with new art ). All feature the MSC expansion code. New card designs from Marvel Jumpstart are Commander -, Legacy -, and Vintage -legal, and individual cards are also legal where already available in other formats.

Marvel Jumpstart is sold in 20-card Jumpstart Boosters , with 24 boosters per booster box . Each booster contains a face card (the "Pack Summary card", or "Theme insert") that indicates the pack's theme and color. The set is also sold in 2-Booster Packs ("2-Packs").

The contents of each pack fit one of 51 randomly chosen themes, with each theme having a "rarity" of common, rare, or mythic rare. Unlike with previous Jumpstart sets, there aren't multiple variations within a specific theme. All boosters contain at least one rare or mythic rare , and one in three boosters includes an extra rare. Within each pack, seven or eight of the pack's 20 cards are lands and the rest are spells.
While structured similarly, the 10 Jumpstart packs that can be found in the Marvel Super Heroes Beginner Box are not part of the Marvel Super Heroes Jumpstart set.
The Marvel Jumpstart cards are available on Magic: The Gathering Arena and are legal in Arena' s eternal formats ( Brawl , Historic , and Timeless ).

The 51 themes feature Hero and Villain sub-themes, alongside equipment and spells drawn from the array of Marvel characters. The rarity of a given pack should not be taken as an indication of power level; but rather how replayable the theme is.
